string.text: Master switch: whether to enable trajectory visualization and enemy highlighting.
Show predicted trajectory for player ranged weapons.
Show predicted firing lines when enemies aim at the player.
Show the actual flight path of fired arrows, bolts, etc.
Highlight enemy ranged units aiming at the player with a red outline.
Use game object icons (poor visuals, but displays correctly when DLSS is enabled in video settings).
Use simple line rendering (extremely high performance, but enabling DLSS in video settings will cause display anomalies).
Enable GameEntity icons for player's handheld ranged weapons.
Enable GameEntity icons for player-controlled siege engines.
Maximum number of enemies to calculate trajectories for simultaneously.
Blurs the player model when aiming upwards to avoid obstructing the view.
Only show trajectory during the drawing or aiming phase.
Enable trajectory prediction for moving targets (lead targeting). EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE: Not recommended for general use.
Slow down time when aiming with enemies nearby.
Remove spread and speed randomization for siege engines. Projectiles fire along precise direction at fixed speed.
Skip fix for multi-projectile siege engines (scatter type). They keep native random behavior.
Display shooting parameters in the info panel when a siege engine fires.
